नवभारताची दिशा आणि स्वावलंबी भारताच्या उ: Understand the direction of New India and the thinking behind entrepreneurship for a self-reliant India.
\"होय, मी तयार आहे.\" नवभारताच्या विचारा: "Yes, I am ready." Connect yourself to the idea of New India — in just one minute.
तुमचा व्यवसाय सुरू करा, मार्गदर्शक बना क: Start your business, become a mentor, or back an entrepreneur.
स्वावलंबी नव्या भारतासाठी तुमचे नाव नोंद: Register your name for a self-reliant New India — read the idea, take the pledge and act on it.
लहान वयातच मुलांना गरजू व्यक्तींना मदत क: The 'Ek Muth Dhanya' (A Fistful of Grain) initiative helps children build the habit of helping people in need from a young age. School students collect grain and make it available to those who need it.
गुणवंत आणि दर्जेदार साहित्यनिर्मिती करणा: Since 2015, the Lokmangal Literature Award has recognised and honoured talented writers who create literature of quality.
शिक्षण क्षेत्रात उल्लेखनीय कार्य करणाऱ्य: Since 2007, the Lokmangal Shikshak Ratna Award has encouraged teachers doing outstanding work in education and model schools.
गरजू रुग्णांना उपचारासाठी आवश्यक औषधे मि: Lokmangal Sanjivani Medical was started on 12 December 2025 so that patients in need can get the medicines their treatment requires.
सोलापूर आणि आसपासच्या नागरिकांसाठी मोफत: A Mega Health Camp was organised to give people in and around Solapur free health check-ups, medicines and surgery.
दिव्यांग बांधवांचे दैनंदिन जीवन अधिक सुल: To make daily life easier for people with disabilities, aids such as Jaipur feet, calipers, crutches, wheelchairs, hearing aids and orthopaedic shoes are given free of charge.
झोपडपट्टी, कामगार आणि गरजू भागातील नागरि: Diagnostic camps are held to check people from slums, workers' colonies and other areas in need for a range of illnesses, free of charge.
रक्ताची निर्मिती कृत्रिम पद्धतीने करता य: Blood cannot be made artificially, so donating blood matters greatly for patients in need.
गरीब, गरजू आणि एकल पालकांच्या मुलांना शि: Children from poor and needy families and of single parents receive notebooks and school supplies free of charge.
नवीन पिढीमध्ये चांगल्या सवयी आणि संस्कार: Residential Balsanskar camps are held to build good habits and values in the new generation.
दिवाळीत किल्ले बांधण्याची परंपरा पुढील प: A fort-building competition is held to pass the Diwali tradition of building forts on to the next generation and to introduce children to the history of Maharashtra. Students form teams through their schools and build the forts under their teachers' guidance.
तरुणांना रोजगाराच्या संधी मिळाव्यात, यास: A job fair was organised jointly by the Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Department and Lokmangal Foundation to open up job opportunities for young people.
जागतिक महिला दिनाच्या निमित्ताने कर्तबगा: On International Women's Day, capable and successful women are honoured. Cultural games and competitions encourage women to take part, and the experience and guidance of successful women is shared with others.
भजन, भारूड आणि कीर्तनाच्या माध्यमातून सा: A Bhajan and Bharud competition is held every year to carry the cultural traditions of bhajan, bharud and kirtan on to the next generation.
दरवर्षी २१ जून रोजी आंतरराष्ट्रीय योग दि: Every year on 21 June, International Yoga Day, yoga training and awareness sessions are held in schools, colleges and other places.
पतीचे निधन झालेल्या, घटस्फोटित, विभक्त क: This initiative gives widowed, divorced, separated and destitute women job opportunities, help with their children's education, and school supplies.
शाळा परिसर आणि लोकवस्तीमध्ये वृक्षारोपण: Trees are planted around schools and neighbourhoods to spread the message of protecting the environment. The focus is on caring for the trees, not just planting them, and on building a sense of responsibility for the environment in children from an early age.
नवरात्रोत्सवानिमित्त महिलांसाठी दांडिया: During Navratri, Dandiya and Garba competitions are held for women. Women can perform in groups or individually, and winners are encouraged with a range of prizes.
